options.name: activation_email
options.description: Whether to send an activation email when the instance is ready or not. Only considered on creation.

options.name: api_endpoint
options.description: URL to API endpint (without trailing slash). Fallback environment variable C(VULTR_API_ENDPOINT).

options.name: api_key
options.description: API key of the Vultr API. Fallback environment variable C(VULTR_API_KEY).

options.name: api_results_per_page
options.description: When receiving large numbers of resources, specify how many results should be returned per call to API. This does not determine how many results are returned; all resources are returned according to other filters. Vultr API maximum is 500. Fallback environment variable C(VULTR_API_RESULTS_PER_PAGE).

options.name: api_retries
options.description: Amount of retries in case of the Vultr API retuns an HTTP error code, such as - 429 Too Many Requests - 500 Internal Server Error - 504 Gateway Time-out Fallback environment variable C(VULTR_API_RETRIES).

options.name: api_retry_max_delay
options.description: Retry backoff delay in seconds is exponential up to this max. value, in seconds. Fallback environment variable C(VULTR_API_RETRY_MAX_DELAY).

options.name: api_timeout
options.description: HTTP timeout to Vultr API. Fallback environment variable C(VULTR_API_TIMEOUT).

options.name: app
options.description: The app deploy name of Vultr OneClick apps. Mutually exclusive with I(image) and I(os).

options.name: backups
options.description: Whether to enable automatic backups or not.

options.name: ddos_protection
options.description: Whether to enable ddos_protection or not.

options.name: enable_ipv6
options.description: Whether to enable IPv6 or not.

options.name: firewall_group
options.description: The firewall group description to assign this instance to.

options.name: hostname
options.description: The hostname to assign to this instance.

options.name: image
options.description: The image deploy name of Vultr Marketplace apps. Mutually exclusive with I(os) and I(app).

options.name: label
options.description: Name of the instance.

options.name: os
options.description: The operating system name. Mutually exclusive with I(image) and I(app).

options.name: plan
options.description: The plan name to use for the instance. Required if the instance does not yet exist.

options.name: region
options.description: Region the instance is deployed into.

options.name: reserved_ipv4
options.description: IP address of the floating IP to use as the main IP of this instance. Only considered on creation.

options.name: skip_wait
options.description: Whether to skip the wait for the instance to be completely ready for access.

options.name: snapshot
options.description: Description or ID of the snapshot. Only considered while creating the instance.

options.name: ssh_keys
options.description: List of SSH key names passed to the instance on creation.

options.name: startup_script
options.description: Name or ID of the startup script to execute on boot. Only considered while creating the instance.

options.name: state
options.description: State of the instance. The state I(reinstalled) was added in version 1.8.0.

options.name: tags
options.description: Tags for the instance.

options.name: user_data
options.description: User data to be passed to the instance.

options.name: user_scheme
options.description: The user scheme used as login user (Linux-only). By default, the I(root) user is configured. Only considered while creating the instance.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Validate SSL certs of the Vultr API.

options.name: vpcs
options.description: A list of VPCs identified by their description to be assigned to the instance.
